submission_guidelines: For novel submissions, send the first three chapters, a clear and detailed synopsis of the complete story, and a little about yourself as the writer. For nonfiction, submit a proposal including what the book is about and why it needs to be published, why you are the ideal person to write it, a summary of the market and audience including similar published books, a chapter of sample text, and an outline of chapters. For Chinese/Taiwanese rights representation, writers should send a synopsis of the title(s) and details about the writer and previous published works.
